description.value:
Scrapper Practice operatives don't bother with fair fights, a fair fight just means somebody planned poorly. They favor close-range blaster work laced with dirty tricks, closing the gap fast and making sure the other side never gets its footing back.

Loud, brash, and utterly practical, these operatives blend suppressive fire with shoves, trips, and well-timed insults, leaving opponents rattled long before the fight is actually over.
